description: A cloud collaboration platform and relational database for building custom apps and workflows
auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow for public integrations; personal access tokens (bearer tokens) for private scripts and individual use.
credential_notes: Developers can sign up for a free Airtable account and generate personal access tokens or configure OAuth integrations self-serve.
api_notes: Comprehensive REST API covering bases, tables, records, fields, comments, webhooks, and metadata operations.
mcp_notes: No official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server published by Airtable.
rationale: Airtable provides a fully documented public REST API and self-serve credential creation (personal access tokens/OAuth) on free accounts.

evidence.note: Describes personal access tokens and OAuth 2.0 authentication methods for the Airtable API.
Introduces the Airtable Web API structure, endpoints, and operations.
Shows a free plan is available for users to sign up and start building.
